outcome: proportion of children requiring ocular surgery
cohort: The study included 1240 new patients aged 0-16 years who presented to the Paediatric Ophthalmology Unit of the University College Hospital, Ibadan, between May 2015 and April 2017.
finding: 11.5% of new paediatric ophthalmology patients required surgical interventions, with cataract and cataract-related indications being the most common reason (85.9%).
